title: On the federal exclusion list: provider numbers in the San Francisco universe
question: Which provider numbers registered in or tied to San Francisco are on the federal list of people and businesses barred from federal health programs?
finding: 24 provider numbers in the project's universe are on the federal exclusion list by exact number; 24 belong to individuals and none to an organization. None of them appears in the Medicaid payment file in a year after the year of exclusion; 2 appear before it or in the same year. No excluded business on the list shares both a name and an address or city with an organization in the universe (9 share a name only, with addresses in other States, and are not shown). The list has 136 entries with a San Francisco address, most of them without a provider number.
how: The federal exclusion list (84,224 entries in the file of 10 November 2026) was matched to the 62,422 provider numbers in the project's universe on the provider number alone. The date and the authority are printed as the list gives them. Medicaid amounts are whatever the payment file shows under that number, as biller or as the person named as giving the service, before, in and after the calendar year of exclusion. Business names were also compared: a name-only match is shown only if the address or the city and State also agree, and none does. 776 individuals in the universe share a name with someone on the list; a shared name is not a match and none is shown.
limits: This screen rests on the federal list and adds nothing to it: a row says only that the list carries that provider number, with the date and authority printed there. The list prints a legal authority code, not an account of what happened, and a number can stay in the national registry long after its holder stopped practising. Most entries on the list have no provider number, so anyone excluded without one is missed, as is anyone reinstated and dropped from the current file. The payment file ends in December 2024 and shows months, not days, so an exclusion in 2024 or later cannot be tested against it and a payment in the year of exclusion may have come before the date. No individual is named in this screen: each is identified by the provider number that the federal list itself publishes, and the list prints the name.
